responsibility: Defines the core target configuration interface for the Blackfin port: preprocessor builtins, ABI and code-generation macros, assembler syntax hooks, section/directive enums, register-printing interfaces, mode-promotion rules, profiling snippets, and shared target data declarations. Unlike bfin.cc, this header supplies the compile-time target description consumed throughout GCC and by generated code, including CPU/workaround builtin definitions, object-format and assembly conventions, and machine macros that characterize Blackfin registers, sections, constants, and calling-sequence related behavior.
same_name_distinction: This is the target configuration header for Blackfin: it provides macros, declarations, assembler-format definitions, builtin preprocessor definitions, and shared target data/interfaces consumed by the rest of GCC. Unlike bfin.cc it does not implement hook behavior, unlike bfin.md it does not encode instruction-selection and scheduling patterns, and unlike bfin.opt it does not define the option table for -m switches.
